text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash has won two G1 races at Tokyo Racecourse, but she responds with a tense smile when I compliment her aptitude for Tokyo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She recounts her experience of getting hopelessly lost in a train station the first day she landed in Japan.
